秦伟说：“臭小子，现在咱俩可以好好说说话了吧？”

王野“嘿嘿”一笑说：“您说，我听着。”

秦伟说：“我就想问问你，为什么这么抵触和我接触？”

王野说：“舅舅既然你问了，我就说说，说的对不对的，您可不准生气。”

秦伟说：“你说，我保证不生气。”

王野说：“舅舅你现在应该是中将吧？”

秦伟点点头，王野继续说：“现在中将的工资也就三百多块钱，说句不该说的，我还看不上你这点工资。而且退一步说，现在有钱也买不到什么东西。”

这一句直接让秦伟满脸黑线。王野继续说：“再一个，我志不在仕途，所以你手里的权利也给我带不来什么好处。反而是这个中将外甥的身份，会给我带来很多不可控的麻烦。您说我应不应该抵触？”

秦伟没好气的说：“什么叫看不上我的工资？”

王野说：“舅舅，今天咱爷俩就说点关起门来的话，你也知道我是在轧钢厂上班。多多少少也能得到一些消息。上个月毛熊的专家撤离，给我们的打击其实挺大的。不说别的，就要求还款一条，就会导致咱们很多年勒紧裤腰带过日子。”

“所以计划经济会一直持续下去，各种票据会一直成为主流。钱的作用就会一直保持现状，别说三百五百，就是三五万也就是那么回事。用钱买不来物资，再多的钱都只是一张纸。而且说句不好听的，，那玩意儿擦屁股都嫌硬。”

秦伟点点头认同王野的观点，可仍不服气的说：“就我的身份，弄点票据还是很容易的。”

王野“嘿嘿”一笑说：“舅舅说这话就没意思了，一次两次没什么事儿。要是长年如此，舅舅那你就当不了中将喽！回顾历史，历朝历代，建国初期对于贪污都是零容忍的。而且我也不缺这些东西，我相信您应该也调查过我。我打猎很厉害的，真要是放开了让我进山，我一个月的收入能顶你一年的工资。”

这下秦伟泄了气，是呀！这小子打猎太厉害了，而且还和好几个厂子有联系，可以光明正大的得到想要的一切。

王野继续说：“再说说麻烦，不说别的，就四九城这个地方到处是官儿，我在底层待着接触的人也就那样，我相信就算真有问题，我赵爷爷也能给我摆平。可是到了您这个层面，那麻烦也就大了，我上个礼拜见了一下大哥的那些朋友。一个个桀骜不驯，一言不合就会大打出手。”

“我也了解过一些东西，这群人对于同档次的人都是私下解决矛盾，但是对于下层的人可不会这么简单了。我不怕他们跟我明着来，可是要是这帮人跟我玩阴的，那我也就只能铤而走险了。这是我不想发生的。”

“现在您既然说坚定的站在我身后，我就有了和他们同等级的实力，所以您的权利只能给我解决身份带来的麻烦。一出一进也就没什么意义了。”

秦伟更无语了，心想：“我踏马一个中将，在这小子眼里简直是一无是处！”

其实不是中将一无是处，而是王野现在的目的太明确了，他只想安全着陆。官越大，着陆越难，王野现在坐拥空间这个外挂，加上空间里无数的财宝，只要是安全着陆了，完完全全可以三代无忧。

人生在世，无外乎名利二字，王野现在什么也不需要，自然让人感觉就是无欲无求，这种人是最难搞的。

秦伟接着说：“那你以后有什么打算？”

王野说：“上班，练武，学医，以后找个媳妇，安安稳稳过日子。”

秦伟没好气的说：“你就这点儿出息呀？就不能想想为国家做贡献什么的。”

王野说：“我上班不就是做贡献呢吗！”

秦伟说：“我知道你的能力，你完全可以去做更大的贡献的。”

王野叹了口气说：“舅舅，我接下来说的话，出了这个屋我就不承认了。今天的话，哪儿说哪儿了。”

Qin Wei said: "You brat, can we have a nice talk now?"

Wang Ye said with a "hehe" smile: "You tell me, I'll listen."

Qin Wei said: "I just want to ask you, why are you so resistant to contact with me?"

Wang Ye said: "Uncle, since you asked, I will tell you whether it is right or not. Don't be angry."

Qin Wei said: "Just tell me, I promise not to be angry."

Wang Ye said: "Uncle, you should be a lieutenant general now, right?"

Qin Wei nodded, and Wang Ye continued: "The current salary of a lieutenant general is only more than three hundred yuan. I shouldn't say it, but I still look down on your salary. And to say the least, you can't buy anything with money now."

This sentence directly made Qin Wei's face full of black lines.Wang Ye continued: "One more thing, I don't have an official career, so the power in your hands will not bring me any benefits. On the contrary, the identity of this lieutenant general's nephew will bring me a lot of uncontrollable troubles. Do you think I should resist?"

Qin Wei said angrily: "What do you mean you don't look down on my salary?"

Wang Ye said: "Uncle, today we and I will talk behind closed doors. You also know that I work in a steel rolling mill. I can get some news more or less. The withdrawal of experts from Mao Xiong last month actually hit us quite hard. If nothing else is said, just asking for repayment will cause us to tighten our belts for many years."

"So the planned economy will continue, and all kinds of bills will always become the mainstream. The role of money will always remain the status quo. Let alone 3,500, just 30,000 to 50,000 is just that. Money cannot buy materials, and no matter how much money you have, it is just a piece of paper. And to put it bluntly, that thing is too hard to wipe your butt."

Qin Wei nodded and agreed with Wang Ye's point of view, but he was still unconvinced and said: "With my status, it is still easy to get some bills."

Wang Ye said with a smile, "It's boring to say this once or twice. If you keep doing this for a long time, uncle, you won't be able to become a lieutenant general! Looking back at history, all dynasties and the early days of the founding of the People's Republic of China have zero tolerance for corruption. And I don't lack these things. I believe you should have investigated me. I am a good hunter. If you let me go into the mountains, my monthly income can equal your year's salary."

Now Qin Wei was discouraged, yes!This guy is really good at hunting, and he has connections with several factories, so he can get everything he wants in a fair and just way.

Wang Ye continued: "Let's talk about trouble. If nothing else, this place in Sijiucheng is full of officials. The people I interact with at the bottom level are just like that. I believe that even if there is a problem, my grandpa Zhao can solve it for me. But when it comes to your level, the trouble will be big. I met my eldest brother's friends last week. They are all unruly and will fight if they disagree."

"I have also learned something. This group of people resolve conflicts privately for people of the same level, but it is not so simple for people at the lower level. I am not afraid that they will come to me openly, but if these people try to play tricks on me, then I will have no choice but to take risks. This is something I don't want to happen."

"Now that you said you will stand firmly behind me, I have the same level of strength as them, so your rights can only help me solve the trouble caused by my identity. There is no point in going in and out."

Qin Wei was even more speechless, thinking: "I am a lieutenant general on horseback, but in the eyes of this boy, I am completely worthless!"

In fact, it's not that the lieutenant general is useless, but that Wang Ye's purpose is too clear now. He just wants to land safely.The bigger the official, the harder it is to land. Wang Ye now has the plug-in of space, plus countless treasures in space. As long as he lands safely, he can have no worries for three generations.

Life in this world is nothing more than fame and fortune. Wang Ye doesn't need anything now. Naturally, it makes people feel that he has no desires and desires. This kind of person is the most difficult to deal with.

Qin Wei then said: "Then what are your plans in the future?"

Wang Ye said: "Go to work, practice martial arts, study medicine, and then find a wife and live a stable life."

Qin Wei said angrily: "Is this all you have to do? You can't think about making a contribution to the country."

Wang Ye said: "I go to work just to make a contribution!"

Qin Wei said: "I know your abilities, and you can definitely make greater contributions."

Wang Ye sighed and said, "Uncle, I won't admit what I say next once I leave this room. What I said today is irrelevant."
